title: Research: Fixed 5% Buyback Experiment v1
body:
## Research question and frozen inputs
Does SELL ON PUBLISHED RISK → LIMIT BUY AT95% OF ACTUAL SALE FILL improve capital and/or shares?
New branch directly from main a14ebf9c268bea5cb01de962edfb98b8df94652a; protocol37065b2af2f3f4a9f7f7aa72ba1ce0b7175a414f committed before calculations and Draft PR created immediately.

Read-only source PR9 @7135c2bdc0653986d93dfcfc66b202a6fb2f741e. Uses the exact sector_flag activation rows that drove its economic experiment; QQQ/VIX are not silently added. Original production actions remain UNKNOWN. 11stocks, September1–November2 2026,44sessions. Frozen prices/signals/calendar/old benchmark + SHA256 provenance in inputs/.

## Results: continuous100000USD equal-initial-sleeve model
|Strategy|Final NAV|Delta vs B&H|MaxDD|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|A Buy & Hold|90888.56|0|21.5175%|
|B Sale-only5%|92905.24|+2016.69|18.6660%|
|B Sale-only10%|94921.93|+4033.38|15.7345%|
|C Sell5%, buy5% lower|91568.52|+679.96|20.0408%|
|D Sell10%, buy5% lower|92248.48|+1359.92|18.5304%|
|E Prior restoration5%|90701.12|−187.43|21.4527%|
|E Prior restoration10%|90513.69|−374.87|21.3875%|

Main fixed5%-price variants:33sales,29completed buybacks,4open lots;87.88% filled, mean16.45/median14 sessions among completed.11final-day signal requests remain unfilled, not fictional sales.
10%-size realized closed net cash surplus1430.68USD plus open-lot marked benefit−70.75USD =1359.92USD advantage vs B&H. Open gross proceeds are never counted as profit.
19/33sales did not have a5% low decline within10 subsequent full sessions.29 eventually filled by cutoff: long waiting and timely risk detection are different questions.

Exact-quantity restoration cannot create more shares than B&H: surplus stays cash, no extra-share reinvestment. Some share deficits remain in4open lots. The portfolio still loses capital in absolute terms; these are relative improvements in a short declining window, not demonstrated investment effectiveness.

## Execution / independent lots
Sales5%/10% ORIGINAL quantity, next regular-session open,5bp adverse slippage+5bp fee; additional-session-delay sensitivity. Initial purchase costs same for every strategy.
Every executed sale creates its own segregated cash/quantity/limit lot. Active no earlier than next session. Gap below limit fills at open; otherwise low touch fills at limit. No same-bar sale/rebuy, debt, repeated same-share sale or double spending. Other free held shares remain sellable without requiring restoration of earlier lots.
No MA/RSI/risk/trend recovery condition for new model. All-or-none exact sold quantity; no cash topups or forced terminal buyback.

Base limit fill never exceeds limit. Stress requires5bp intraday penetration and worsens gap fills by5bp capped at limit. Commission5bp on buys. Daily OHLC touch does not prove actual queue/liquidity execution; intraday high/low ordering recorded as uncertain.
Threshold sensitivity3/7/10% published alongside frozen5%; both sale sizes, delay1/2, base/stress,41total scenarios including original E. No optimized configuration selected.

E is re-executed using unchanged archived Node source;55stock/config summaries match published PR9, and B&H matches independent new simulator. New model changes both free-share gate and buy rule, so its entire difference vs E is not attributed solely to buy timing. Sale-only isolates the cost of early re-entry.

## Artifacts and validation
37new files under reports/fixed-5pct-buyback-v1/ and research/fixed_5pct_buyback/: Russian executive summary/report, complete sales/limit orders/buys/cycles, sale quality, opportunity costs, daily stock/portfolio NAV, comparisons/sensitivity/wait statistics, sources, deterministic offline code/tests and hashes.

43Python tests passed:2existing main +30execution +11cross-ledger checks;0failures,1environment deprecation warning. Includes exact lot cash/NAV identity, missed dividends, no lookahead in daily prefixes, no double counting, limit activation/gaps/stress, fees/delays and preserved source snapshots.
Clean worktree fetched from GitHub at1e05312abc873e107a6b1a1b39da66bcd4813e10 reproduced all outputs byte-identically with empty git diff;43tests passed again. Evidence in verification.json.

Latest published commit:ef1a3a76c1c0d455f48a9d787f1c04961c244b91.

## Limits / stop
Only3executed common signal dates across correlated stocks;33rows are not33independent market trials. Original publication/vintage/PIT attestations and production records absent; future lows/highs used only as outcome labels or daily limit-fill assumptions. Full2021–2026 backtest NOT completed: audit has no corresponding complete frozen sector-signal sequence.
No production engine changes/calls, real orders, merge or deploy. No parameter fitting or live-readiness claim. Draft stays open; research stops at this checkpoint.
